message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: buying tax invoices (发票) from others at low price, then selling them to companies. This is illegal sale of false tax invoices, i.e., counterfeit tax invoices. The crime is "伪造、变造发票罪" (forgery or alteration of invoices). In Chinese criminal law, selling forged invoices is "买卖发票罪"? Actually the offense is "伪造、变造发票罪" under Article 205 of Criminal Law. The act of buying and selling counterfeit invoices is covered. So charge: 伪造、变造发票罪. Also possibly "非法买卖发票罪"? But law: Article 205: 伪造、变造发票罪 includes manufacturing, buying, selling, using. So one charge.

Check correction rules: list only statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So we should output "伪造、变造发票". No "罪". If multiple, separate with semicolons. Only one.

Thus final answer: [罪名]伪造、变造发票<eoa>
